name: 34691 · Holiday, FL
findings: ZIP 34691 (Holiday) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34691 (Holiday) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34691 (Holiday) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
